sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.

v4.9.341 (October 4, 2026)

v4.9.339 (October 4, 2026)

  • AI Session & Rate Limit Elimination for Administrators: Super Admins and administrators automatically bypass quota restrictions and 6-hour session window limits with enterprise unlimited capacity. Elevated default free-tier workspace credit ceilings.

v4.9.338 (October 3, 2026)

  • Dynamic Super Admin PWA App Icon Badging: Auto-generated badged PWA app icons and dynamic Web App Manifest resolution for super admin accounts with monochromatic high-contrast 'ADMIN' badges. Synchronized secure administrator credential provisioning across local and remote environments.

v4.9.334 (October 3, 2026)

  • AI Starter Prompts Grid & 1-Click Code Connector in Add Theme Wizard: Overhauled the Add Theme Wizard (#atw) to prioritize AI HTML & Tailwind (Claude & ChatGPT). Step 2 features a curated grid of 5 production template prompts (Creative Agency & Video Studio, AI SaaS & Software Landing, B2B Advisory & Management Consulting, Photography Studio & Production House, Custom Niche Studio) equipped with 1-click "\ud83d\udccb Copy Prompt for Claude / ChatGPT" buttons. Added dual-mode code connector supporting direct HTML code paste / dropzone with live sandboxed preview and GitHub repo syncing.
  • Native Lead Form Ingestion & Live Site Interception: Enhanced native form integration across static builds (cora_render_nextjs_static_build) and REST endpoints (/wp-json/cora-canvas/v1/nextjs/forms/submit). Standard HTML forms and embedded Cora Form widgets (.cora-form-embed) submit leads directly into the CRM database (wp_cora_leads) with instant in-place monochromatic confirmation.

v4.9.329 (October 3, 2026)

  • Automated Disk & Inode Recovery and Resilient Dependency Installation: Proactively purges stale npm caches (~/.npm/_cacache) and redundant node_modules from inactive build folders to prevent CloudLinux inode quota exhaustion (-122 EDQUOT). Enhanced npm installation with self-healing fallback (npm install --no-audit || (rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install)) to permanently eliminate directory rename locks (ENOTEMPTY).
  • Low-Memory Webpack Optimization & Process Limit Resilience: Added low-memory Webpack configuration (splitChunks = false, minimize = false, NODE_OPTIONS=\"--max-old-space-size=768\", RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1) to prevent CloudLinux LVE memory termination (SIGKILL) on large Next.js application suites.
  • Meaningful Error Diagnostics & 1-Click Recovery: Expanded real-time error matcher in the Add Theme Wizard Step 3 terminal with specific diagnostic cards for locked directories, inode quotas, and memory limits with 1-click "\u26a1 Retry Build" actions.

v4.9.328 (October 3, 2026)

  • Next.js Dynamic & API Routes Static Compilation Architecture: Eliminated static export breakage on repos containing API routes or dynamic server components by avoiding forced output: 'export' constraints. Auto-configured resilient single-CPU Next.js compilation (experimental.cpus = 1, workerThreads = false) to prevent worker pool spawning crashes on shared hosting. Pre-populated essential environment variables (WORDPRESS_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, SESSION_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_SECRET) preventing missing env var failures during page data collection. Upgraded static route exporter to recursively extract App Router group folders (e.g. (portal)) and compile comprehensive static HTML distribution files into out/ for seamless static hosting on Cora.

v4.9.327 (October 3, 2026)

  • Next.js Compilation CLI Fix & Manifest Route Extraction: Fixed a build failure caused by invalid --webpack CLI option in Next.js 14/15 compilation. Enhanced static route exporter (cora_export_html.mjs) to recursively copy server-rendered HTML from .next/server/app and .next/server/pages, parse all manifest files, and bundle client assets for zero-latency static hosting on Cora.

v4.9.326 (October 3, 2026)

  • Theme Importer Real-Time Build Terminal & Meaningful Error Diagnostics: Upgraded Step 3 of the Add Theme Wizard to seamlessly transition into a live 5-step build terminal upon theme creation/import. Provides animated progressive checklist updates, live terminal log streaming, and meaningful root-cause diagnostic error cards (handling memory ceilings, GitHub branch access, dependency resolutions, and syntax failures) with 1-click "\u26a1 Retry Build" and "← Edit Configuration" controls.
  • WebAssembly Memory Hardening & Low-Memory Static Exporter Fallback: Hardened Node.js compilation and route exporter with constrained memory flags (--max-old-space-size=512, --no-wasm-code-gc, --disable-wasm-trap-handler) preventing Undici/llhttp Wasm allocation crashes on shared hosting environments and guaranteeing client-side static route export.

v4.9.325 (October 3, 2026)

  • Zero-Config Native Next.js ISR & Static Route Previews on Cora: Eliminated the external deployment URL requirement on Next.js page actions. Clicking the lightning bolt (\u26a1 Rebuild / ISR) or \ud83d\udc41 Preview on page rows now automatically compiles and renders the static route directly on Cora Workspace (/site/[route]) with zero external server dependencies and instantaneous monochromatic toast feedback.

v4.9.324 (October 3, 2026)

  • Next.js Automated Static HTML Route Exporter & Zero-Config Build Pipeline: Added automated Node.js static HTML exporter pipeline executing immediately after Next.js compilation. Automatically extracts all registered App Router and Pages Router paths, binds compiled CSS bundles and JS chunks, and outputs static HTML files and assets directly into the distribution folder for instantaneous zero-latency rendering.

v4.9.323 (October 3, 2026)

  • Next.js Shared Hosting Compiler Hardening & Static Asset Bundling: Hardened Next.js static build engine for CloudLinux/Hostinger shared hosting environments. Auto-configures single-CPU compilation (experimental.cpus = 1, UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE = 1, NEXT_CPU_COUNT = 1), precompiles Tailwind v4 without spawning background worker threads, patches static sitemap requirements, ensures full devDependencies installation, and guarantees _next/static asset chunk extraction into the final static distribution.

v4.9.322 (October 3, 2026)

Connected static build execution directly to theme creation (cora_ajax_canvas_create_theme), enabled dynamic agency ID resolution, and added auto-compilation on connector screen load.

v4.9.321 (October 3, 2026)

Enhanced GitHub repository scanning and static build engine with strict Next.js validation, rejecting non-Next.js repositories while guaranteeing seamless static export execution across multi-repo connections.

v4.9.320 (October 3, 2026)

Added early static asset interceptor to cora_workspace_handle_workspace_route on init priority 1, ensuring /_next/*, /brand/*, and static files stream instantly with zero template overhead.

v4.9.319 (October 3, 2026)

Added early static asset interceptor and global live theme fallback, ensuring Next.js static builds stream compiled CSS, JS chunks, and assets directly with instantaneous HTTP 200 responses.

v4.9.316 (October 3, 2026)

Added dedicated 'Next.js' badge indicators across Active and Draft theme rosters in Canvas (views/view-canvas.php). Connected the Next.js route scanner to the theme creation pipeline (wizardSave and cora_ajax_canvas_create_theme), persisting all scanned repository routes as registered Next.js pages with server-side scan fallback.

v4.9.312 (October 1, 2026)

Upgraded cora_nextjs_scan_routes with dual authorization header negotiation (trying both token <pat> and Bearer <pat>) and added support for monorepo/subfolder Next.js routing structures (e.g. cora-frontend/app/page.tsx).

v4.9.311 (October 1, 2026)

  • Next.js Private Repository Support & GitHub Branch Auto-Discovery: Fixed an issue where the Add Theme wizard would hang on 'Scanning...' and 'Loading branches from GitHub...'. Defined scoped variables (safeAjaxUrl, safeNonce, and showToast) to eliminate JavaScript runtime reference errors. Enhanced cora_nextjs_scan_routes to seamlessly support both public and private GitHub repositories via Personal Access Tokens (Classic PAT with repo scope or Fine-Grained PAT with Contents: Read-only). Added real-time branch roster querying (/branches), automatic default branch detection (e.g., main vs master), graceful branch fallback, and clear contextual feedback on HTTP 401, 403, and 404 responses.

v4.9.310 (October 1, 2026)

Also added an explicit Next.js Native option to the structure initialization modal.

  • Unified Notification Trigger & Drawer Consolidation: Eliminated the redundant mini popover card from the sidebar bottom user widget. Connected the sidebar bottom bell icon directly to the primary, canonical Notifications Drawer (window.coraToggleNotificationDrawer()) shared by the topbar header bell icon. Cleaned up redundant DOM containers, click outside handlers, and CSS rules while preserving real-time unread badge counter synchronization across both triggers.

Resolved URL query string parsing in window.coraNavigateTo to preserve URL parameters (?cv_action=edit_live) without percent-encoding question marks into path slugs.

Invoices published from the financial suite now immediately appear in Document Vault (/workspace/vault) with active E-Sign tracking, public share tokens, and statutory GST item breakdowns.
  • Robust Form Pre-Population & Nonce Gatekeeping: Added robust client fallbacks and pre-populated defaults to the 3-step GST invoice drawer, hardened multi-tier AJAX URL and security token resolution, and enabled 1-click publish capability from any step.

Added novalidate to the creator form, removed native blocking attributes, and implemented robust multi-step JavaScript validation (window.coraSubmitInvoice and window.coraGoInvStep) with automatic step focusing, visual highlight rings, and monochromatic error toast guidance.
  • Complete Line Items Serialization & Document Vault Contract Linking: Upgraded cora_ajax_create_invoice backend and frontend controllers to correctly serialize dynamic line items (SAC codes, quantities, rates, totals), calculate 18% GST (CGST/SGST/IGST), and automatically generate linked E-Sign contract blueprints in Document Vault (wp_cora_vault_documents).
